events_seen: CUT (Sep 07 (today)): Charles released Roman Wilson (WR, PIT).
CUT (Sep 07 (today)): Mitchum released Luke McCaffrey (WR, WAS).
CUT (Sep 07 (today)): Mitchum released Jerome Ford (RB, WAS).
FREE AGENT ADD (Sep 07 (today)): Wingard added Samaje Perine (RB, CIN) (dropped Will Levis (QB, FA)).
CUT (Sep 04 (3 days ago)): Mitchum released Michael Trigg (TE, DAL).
CUT (Sep 04 (3 days ago)): Mitchum released Xavier Restrepo (WR, TEN).
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 03 (4 days ago)): Corbishley added Roschon Johnson (RB, CHI) for $1 FAAB.
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 02 (5 days ago)): Drew added Camden Brown (WR, DAL) (dropped Zavier Scott (RB, CHI)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 02 (5 days ago)): Kevin added Jaleel McLaughlin (RB, CLE) for $2 FAAB.
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 02 (5 days ago)): Adam added George Holani (RB, SEA) (dropped Damien Martinez (RB, FA)).

tweets.name: Dina Ravioli
tweets.text: Multiple sources confirm Mitchum has now released four players in the last four days — Trigg three days ago, Restrepo three days ago, McCaffrey and Ford both today. That's not roster trimming. I'm told internally there is no defined direction right now, and the people around the situation are starting to say that quietly out loud. DEEP at $75.34 and sliding.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Mitchum has released FOUR players since Thursday and I refuse to believe there is a plan here. McCaffrey AND Jerome Ford in the same morning? On the same roster? Someone call a wellness check on Deepwater Supply Co.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: DEEP at $75.34 is a number I can no longer defend. Four cuts in four days, no flagship asset, no direction, the board has been asking for a buy-or-sell call all offseason and the answer they keep getting is 'neither, actually, we're just going to let people go.' That is not a strategy. That is a slow leak.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: Wingard dropped Will Levis — a warm-bodied quarterback, which in superflex is a luxury you do not casually discard — to add Samaje Perine off the street. I will not sit here and pretend that is a neutral transaction. SDR at $63.56, down six percent, hoarding picks, releasing production, and now thinning its QB room. The market is not wrong about this one.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I said before the season that Sovereign's pick-hoarding would eventually require sacrificing real roster pieces to stay liquid, and dropping Levis for Perine today is exactly that trade-off materializing in real time. SDR is not building toward a window. SDR is deferring toward one. There's a difference and it costs you eventually.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: George Holani joining Helix five days ago got ignored because everyone was busy watching the Mitchum implosion, but Seattle's backfield situation is genuinely interesting depth-chart-wise right now. Adam trades in depth and patience. HLX at $92.02 is cheap for a roster that keeps finding pieces in the margins.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: Charles cutting Roman Wilson today after adding him eight days ago is the kind of roster hygiene that only reads as ruthless because Crownline has the depth to make it look easy. That spot opened, Wilson auditioned, Wilson didn't make the cut. CROWN at $133.12 — the roster is that tight and that intentional about it.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Tonight we are devoting a full segment to the Deepwater situation — four cuts in four days, $75.34 and drifting, and still no coherent answer from the Mitchum camp on what the roster is supposed to look like. Terrence has already recorded his verdict. Bo has opinions and zero preparation. Seven o'clock.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Just to level-set before tonight's show: Atlas is up 6.8% on the week, Sovereign is down 6.3%, and Deepwater has released four players since Thursday. That's the actual story of this market window and somehow we spent forty minutes in the pre-show meeting talking about Fronge being in Cuba. We're getting it together. Seven o'clock.
